title: Lobster Films — Le Voyage dans la Lune story tableaux
author: Lobster Films
notes: Film-restorer story guide; its 15 headings are a retelling, not a verified count of original 1902 tableaux. Supports character names and event labels. Alcofribras is the spelling here; alternate spellings retained.

title: Cinémathèque française — surviving astronomer costume
author: La Cinémathèque française
notes: Original robe in the first two tableaux; distinguishes its trim from Barbenfouillis’s near-identical robe and identifies Méliès as Barbenfouillis.

title: Cinémathèque française — Labisse Selenite reconstruction
author: La Cinémathèque française
notes: Later cardboard reconstruction after a 1937 drawing; not an original 1902 suit, material or colour record. Museum identifies Folies Bergère acrobats as Selenite performers.

title: Cinémathèque française — Les Sélénites drawing
author: La Cinémathèque française
notes: Retrospective drawing; existing M06/A04 preserve date and reproduction uncertainty.

title: MoMA — The Dream drawing
author: The Museum of Modern Art
notes: Later scene drawing; catalogue title includes Phoebus while the restorer’s retelling names Phoebe. Keep that title discrepancy; do not rename the visible crescent woman from the later title.

title: MoMA — Giant Mushroom Grotto drawing
author: The Museum of Modern Art
notes: Retrospective grotto drawing; a variation on film staging rather than a verified 1902 set plan.

title: MoMA — lunar landing and Earth drawing
author: The Museum of Modern Art
notes: Later landing/Earth scene; title calls the vehicle a rocket shell. Visual game specification remains the film’s finless bullet-shaped shell.

title: MoMA — Moon-eye drawing
author: The Museum of Modern Art
notes: Retrospective Moon-eye drawing, existing M01; not preproduction art.

title: Cinémathèque française — Georges Méliès par ses archives
author: Tania Capron / La Cinémathèque française
notes: Distinguishes original design records from later recompositions and describes theatrical staging. Supports provenance method, not invented boss mechanics.

title: MoMA — To Save and Project programme announcement
author: The Museum of Modern Art
notes: Programme documents the restored hand-coloured version and the restoration partners. Monochrome remains this project’s art direction.

title: Ciclic — Le Voyage dans la Lune teacher guide
author: Ciclic
notes: Search-index extract checked for cast: Méliès [Barbenfouillis], Bleuette Bernon [Phoebe], François Lallement [officer], Henri Delannoy [pilot]. Full PDF did not open in this session; these performer-role assignments are published attributions, not independently verified identities in stills.

title: BFI Player — A Trip to the Moon
author: British Film Institute
notes: Institutional film record and viewing entry. Does not supply individual cast identities for every visible performer.

title: Georges Méliès — film frames and production photographs in the existing library
author: Georges Méliès; reproductions served by Wikimedia Commons
publisher: Georges Méliès; reproductions served by Wikimedia Commons
notes: Primary visual evidence is each linked F01–F13/A01–A17/USER01 record, with its direct Commons page and credit. Category link is only an entry point. No new archival pixels were downloaded; visual descriptions inherit specific legacy reference URLs.

title: Cinémathèque française — Le Voyage dans la Lune film record and full cast
author: La Cinémathèque française
notes: Full published cast credits checked. Retains surnames Brunnet, Delpierre, Farjaux and Kelm as given; no mapping from those actor names to the five story-guide companion names is established. Runtime metadata varies by presentation, so it does not set game-level duration.

title: Festival de Cannes — Le Voyage dans la Lune, Cannes Classics 2011
author: Festival de Cannes
notes: Official production year, six-traveller synopsis and four performer/role credits; the listed AIR score belongs to the modern restoration presentation, not a verified 1902 original score.
